# Immutable historical retention test base

These files are exact Git blobs from commit `3e382d94ce914e1b89fcc04c688f7d8a2a7f6b89`.
They preserve the source needed to apply and host-test the published retention
experiment after the release detector evolves. The manifest records SHA-256.
No hardware, measurement or new algorithm is represented by this fixture.
The full compile job checks out the same commit instead of using this subset.
GPL-3.0-or-later, as in the original repository. Do not update these files to
match the current detector; add current-policy tests separately.
